questions.question: Which of the following can help secure your sensitive data in Amazon S3? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Delete the encryption keys once your data is encrypted.
With AWS you do not need to worry about encryption.
Encrypt the data prior to uploading it.
Delete all IAM users that have access to S3.

questions.explanation: To secure sensitive S3 data, enable S3 encryption (C) (server-side encryption) and/or encrypt the data before uploading it (D) (client-side encryption). Deleting encryption keys or all IAM users would lock you out or remove access control, and AWS does not handle encryption for you automatically.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps developers compile and test their code?
questions.explanation: AWS CodeBuild compiles source code and runs tests, producing deployable artifacts. CodeCommit stores code, CodeDeploy deploys it, and CloudEndure is migration/DR.

questions.question: Which of the following will affect how much you are charged for storing objects in S3? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Using default encryption for any number of S3 buckets.
The number of EBS volumes attached to your instances.
The storage class used for the objects stored.
The total size in gigabytes of all objects stored.

questions.explanation: S3 storage charges depend on the storage class used (C) and the total size in gigabytes of objects stored (E). Default encryption, EBS volumes, and creating/deleting buckets do not drive object storage cost.

questions.question: What does the Amazon CloudFront service provide? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Tracks user activity and APl usage.
Increases application availability by caching at the edge.
Stores archived data at very low costs.
Delivers content to end users with low latency.

questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront increases availability by caching content at edge locations (B) and delivers content to users with low latency (E). API/activity tracking is CloudTrail, low-cost archival is Glacier, and DR is a separate concern.

questions.question: You are facing a lot of problems with your current contact center. Which service provides a cloud-based contact center that can deliver a better service for your customers?
questions.explanation: Amazon Connect is a cloud-based contact center service for delivering better customer service. Lightsail is simple VPS hosting, Direct Connect is networking, and Elastic Beanstalk is app deployment.

questions.question: You have migrated your application to AWS recently. How can you view the AWS costs applied to your account?

options.text: Using the AWS Cost & Usage Report.
Using the AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) dashboard.
Using the AWS CloudWatch logs dashboard.

questions.explanation: The AWS Cost & Usage Report shows the detailed AWS costs applied to your account. The TCO dashboard compares on-premises vs AWS, CloudWatch logs are operational, and the VPC dashboard is networking.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance types? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: Valid Reserved Instance types are Convertible (A) and Standard (E). 'Expedited,' 'Bulk,' and 'Spot' are not RI types (Spot is a separate purchasing model).

questions.question: Which of the following services gives you access to all AWS auditor-issued reports and certifications?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS auditor-issued compliance reports and certifications (e.g., SOC, ISO, PCI). Config tracks configuration, CloudWatch monitors, and CloudTrail logs API calls.

questions.question: You manage a blog on AWS that has different environments: development, testing, and production. What can you use to create a custom console for each environment to view and manage your resources easily?
questions.explanation: AWS Resource Groups let you create custom groupings (e.g., per environment) to view and manage related resources together. Placement Groups affect instance placement, and Tag Editor edits tags rather than building consoles.

questions.question: Which AWS service collects metrics from running EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch collects metrics (CPU, network, etc.) from running EC2 instances. Inspector scans for vulnerabilities, CloudFormation provisions resources, and CloudTrail logs API activity.

questions.question: Your web application currently faces performance issues and suffers from long load times. Which of the following AWS services could help fix these issues and improve performance?
questions.explanation: AWS X-Ray traces requests through your application to pinpoint performance bottlenecks and long load times. Detective, Security Hub, and Shield are security services, not performance tracing tools.

questions.question: Which of the following compute resources are serverless? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS Fargate (B) and AWS Lambda (C) are serverless compute — no servers to manage. EC2, ECS (on EC2), and EMR are server-based.

questions.question: For compliance and regulatory purposes, a government agency requires that their applications must run on hardware that is dedicated to them only. How can you meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: EC2 Dedicated Hosts provide physical servers dedicated to a single customer, meeting compliance requirements for isolated hardware. Reserved, Spot, and On-Demand instances run on shared hardware by default.

questions.question: Which AWS Cost Governance best practice recommends refining workloads regularly to make the most of existing AWS resources and reduce costs?
questions.explanation: Architecture Optimization is the cost-governance practice of regularly refining workloads to use existing resources efficiently and cut costs. Tagging enforcement, budgeting, and resource controls are separate governance practices.

questions.question: An organization needs to build a financial application that requires support for ACID transactions. Which AWS database service is most appropriate in this case?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS supports ACID-compliant relational transactions needed for a financial application. Redshift is analytics, CloudHSM is key storage, and DMS is migration.

questions.question: What can you use to assign permissions directly to an IAM user?
questions.explanation: You assign permissions to an IAM user by attaching an IAM policy (directly or via a group). An IAM group is a collection of users, a role is assumed for temporary access, and 'IAM Identity' is not a permission mechanism.

questions.question: The owner of an E-Commerce application notices that the compute capacity requirements vary heavily from time to time. What makes AWS more economical than traditional data centers for this type of application?

options.text: AWS allows customers to launch powerful EC2 instances to handle spikes in load.
AWS allows customers to pay upfront to get bigger discounts.
AWS allows customers to launch and terminate EC2 instances based on demand.
AWS allows customers to choose cheaper types of EC2 instances that best fit their needs.

questions.explanation: AWS is more economical for variable workloads because you can launch and terminate EC2 instances based on demand, paying only for what you use. Upfront discounts and instance choice help but do not address fluctuating demand directly.

questions.question: Amazon RDS supports multiple database engines to choose from. Which of the following is not one of them?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, and Aurora — but not Teradata. So Teradata is the engine RDS does not offer.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS services would help you migrate on-premise databases to AWS?
questions.explanation: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) migrates on-premises databases to AWS, often with minimal downtime. S3 Transfer Acceleration speeds uploads, Directory Service is identity, and Transit Gateway is networking.

questions.question: For new AWS customers, what is the EASIEST way to launch a simple WordPress website on AWS?

options.text: Run WordPress on an Amazon Lightsail instance.
Install WordPress on an Amazon EC2 instance.
Use the Amazon S3 Web hosting feature.
Host the website directly on AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK).

questions.explanation: Amazon Lightsail is the easiest way for new customers to launch a simple WordPress site, with preconfigured blueprints and bundled pricing. Installing on EC2 is more work, S3 hosts static sites only, and CDK is a developer IaC framework.

questions.question: Which of the following would you use to manage your encryption keys in the AWS Cloud? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS KMS (A) and AWS CloudHSM (E) manage encryption keys in the cloud (KMS is the managed service; CloudHSM offers dedicated hardware modules). Certificate Manager handles certs, and CodeDeploy/CodeCommit are developer tools.

questions.question: Which of the following services allows you to install and run custom relational database software?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 lets you install and run custom/self-managed relational database software with full control. Amazon RDS is managed (you cannot install arbitrary DB software), and Cognito/Inspector are unrelated.

questions.question: Your application requirements for CPU and RAM are changing in an unpredictable way. Which service can be used to dynamically adjust these resources based on load?
questions.explanation: AWS Auto Scaling dynamically adjusts compute capacity (adding/removing instances) as load changes unpredictably. ELB distributes traffic, Route 53 is DNS, and ECS runs containers.

questions.question: A company has infrastructure hosted in an on-premises data center. They currently have an operations team that takes care of identity management. If they decide to migrate to the AWS cloud, which of the following services would help them perform the same role in AWS?
questions.explanation: AWS IAM performs identity and access management in AWS, the same role the on-premises operations team handled. Outposts is hybrid hardware, Redshift is analytics, and 'AWS Federation' is a feature, not a standalone service for this role.

questions.question: What are some key design principles for designing public cloud systems? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Reserved capacity instead of on demand.
Disposable resources instead of fixed servers.
Multi-AZ deployments instead of multi-region deployments.

questions.explanation: Key cloud design principles include favoring loose coupling over tight coupling (B) and using disposable resources instead of fixed servers (D). Reserved-only capacity, self-managed servers, and limiting to multi-AZ are not the recommended principles.

questions.question: Where can AWS account owners get a list of all users in their account, including the status of their AWS credentials?
questions.explanation: The IAM Credential Report lists all users in the account along with the status of their credentials (passwords, access keys, MFA). CloudTrail logs activity, Artifact has compliance docs, and the Cost & Usage Report is billing.

questions.question: Which of the following services enables you to easily generate and use your own encryption keys in the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudHSM lets you generate and use your own encryption keys on dedicated, single-tenant hardware security modules. Shield/WAF are for protection, and Certificate Manager handles certificates.

questions.question: You have developed a web application targeting a global audience. Which of the following will help you achieve the highest redundancy and fault tolerance from an infrastructure perspective?

options.text: There is no need to architect for these capabilities in AWS, as AWS is redundant by default.
Deploy the application in a single Availability Zone.
Deploy the application in multiple Availability Zones in a single AWS region.
Deploy the application in multiple Availability Zones in multiple AWS regions.

questions.explanation: The highest redundancy and fault tolerance comes from deploying across multiple Availability Zones in multiple AWS Regions, surviving even a full-Region failure. AWS is not redundant by default for your workload, and single-AZ/single-Region designs are less resilient.

questions.question: For some services, AWS automatically replicates data across multiple Availability Zones to provide fault tolerance in the event of a server failure or Availability Zone outage. Select TWO services that automatically replicate data across Availability Zones.
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 (B) and Amazon DynamoDB (C) automatically replicate data across multiple Availability Zones for durability and fault tolerance. Instance Store is ephemeral, Route 53 is DNS, and VPN is connectivity.

questions.question: Which of the following factors affect Amazon CloudFront cost? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront cost is driven by the number of requests (A) and traffic distribution / data transfer out by geographic region (B). Volumes, instance type, and storage class are not CloudFront cost factors.

questions.question: Which of the following resources can an AWS customer use to learn more about prohibited uses of the services offered by AWS?
questions.explanation: The AWS Acceptable Use Policy describes prohibited uses of AWS services. SCPs restrict account actions, Artifact provides compliance docs, and Budgets manages cost.

questions.question: Which of the following security resources are available to any user for free? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: Free security resources available to anyone include AWS Security Bulletins (A) and the AWS Security Blog (D). A TAM and classroom training are paid, and the Support API requires a paid plan.

questions.question: How can you protect data stored on Amazon S3 from accidental deletion?
questions.explanation: Enabling S3 Versioning preserves previous versions of objects, protecting against accidental deletion or overwrite. Bucket policies and lifecycle policies serve other purposes, and disabling replication does not prevent deletion.

questions.question: Which of the following is the responsibility of AWS according to the AWS Shared Responsibility Model?
questions.explanation: Securing Regions and Edge Locations (the global physical infrastructure) is AWS's responsibility under the Shared Responsibility Model. Auditing, usage monitoring, and access control to resources are customer responsibilities.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS support plans provides access to only the seven core AWS Trusted Advisor checks?
questions.explanation: The Basic and Developer Support plans provide access to only the core (seven) Trusted Advisor checks; Business and Enterprise unlock the full set of checks.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of using AWS Lambda?

options.text: AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning or managing servers.
AWS Lambda provides resizable compute capacity in the cloud.
There is no charge when your AWS Lambda code is not running.
AWS Lambda can be called directly from any mobile app.

questions.explanation: 'Provides resizable compute capacity in the cloud' describes Amazon EC2, not AWS Lambda, so it is NOT a Lambda benefit. Lambda's real benefits include running code without managing servers, no charge when idle, and being directly invokable from mobile, web, and IoT apps.

questions.question: How does AWS help customers achieve compliance in the cloud?

options.text: It's not possible to meet regulatory compliance requirements in the Cloud.
AWS applies the most common Cloud security standards, and is responsible for complying with customers’ applicable laws and regulations.
AWS has many common assurance certifications such as ISO 9001 and HIPAA.
Many AWS services are assessed regularly to comply with local laws and regulations.

questions.explanation: AWS helps customers achieve compliance by holding many common assurance certifications and attestations (such as ISO and SOC). AWS is not responsible for the customer's own legal compliance, and compliance in the cloud is absolutely achievable.

questions.question: Who is responsible for scaling a DynamoDB database in the AWS Shared Responsibility Model?
questions.explanation: Because Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed service, AWS is responsible for scaling it under the Shared Responsibility Model. Your teams manage data and access, not the underlying scaling.

questions.question: You are working as a web app developer. You are currently facing issues in media playback for mobile devices because your media format is not supported. Which of the following AWS services can help you convert your media into another format?
questions.explanation: Amazon Elastic Transcoder converts media files into formats playable on various devices. Pinpoint is marketing engagement, S3 is storage, and Rekognition is image/video analysis.

questions.question: What are the benefits of the AWS Organizations service? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Help organizations design and maintain an accelerated path to successful cloud adoption.
Help organization achieve their desired business outcomes with AWS.
Consolidate billing across multiple AWS accounts.

questions.explanation: AWS Organizations lets you control access to AWS services across accounts (via Service Control Policies) (A) and consolidate billing across multiple accounts (E). Cloud-adoption roadmaps (CAF) and business-outcome help (Professional Services) are different offerings.

questions.question: Which AWS service allows you to build a data warehouse in the cloud?
questions.explanation: Amazon Redshift is AWS's cloud data warehouse for large-scale analytics. Shield is DDoS protection, RDS is transactional, and Comprehend is NLP.

questions.question: What AWS service allows you to buy third-party software solutions and services that run on AWS resources?
questions.explanation: AWS Marketplace is the online store for buying third-party software solutions and services that run on AWS. Application Discovery Service inventories servers, DevPay is retired, and Resource Groups organize resources.

questions.question: Which of the following services is an AWS repository management system that allows for storing, versioning, and managing your application code?
questions.explanation: AWS CodeCommit is a managed source-control (repository) service for storing, versioning, and managing application code. CodePipeline orchestrates CI/CD, X-Ray traces requests, and Inspector scans for vulnerabilities.

questions.question: Which AWS service can be used to route end users to the nearest AWS Region to reduce latency?
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 can route end users to the nearest/lowest-latency AWS Region using latency-based or geolocation routing. Cognito, Systems Manager, and Cloud9 do not perform DNS-based latency routing.

questions.question: Which feature enables users to sign into their AWS accounts with their existing corporate credentials?
questions.explanation: Identity Federation lets users sign in to AWS using their existing corporate credentials (via SAML/identity providers). Access keys, IAM permissions, and WAF rules do not provide corporate single sign-on.

questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, what are the controls that customers fully inherit from AWS? (Choose TWO)
questions.explanation: Customers fully inherit data center security controls (C) and environmental controls (D) from AWS — AWS owns the facilities entirely. Awareness & training, communications, and resource configuration are shared or customer controls.

questions.question: What can you access by visiting the URL: ?
questions.explanation: The AWS Service Health Dashboard shows the current operational status of AWS services across Regions. (The URL in the question was omitted, but the dashboard is the public service-status page.)

questions.question: Which of the following procedures can reduce latency when your end users are retrieving data? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Store media assets in the region closest to your end users.
Store media assets on an additional EBS volume and increase the capacity of your server.
Replicate media assets to at least two availability zones.
Reduce the size of media assets using the Amazon Elastic Transcoder.
Store media assets in S3 and use CloudFront to distribute these assets.

questions.explanation: To reduce retrieval latency, store assets in the Region closest to your end users (A) and serve them from S3 via CloudFront (E) so content is cached at edge locations near users. Adding EBS capacity, multi-AZ replication, or transcoding does not primarily reduce geographic latency.

questions.question: Which of the following are part of the seven design principles for security in the cloud? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Use manual monitoring techniques to protect your AWS resources.
Use IAM roles to grant temporary access instead of long-term credentials.
Scale horizontally to protect from failures.
Never store sensitive data in the cloud.

questions.explanation: Among the security design principles are using IAM roles for temporary credentials instead of long-term ones (B) and enabling real-time traceability (D) (logging/monitoring). Manual monitoring and 'never store data in the cloud' are not recommended security principles.

questions.question: A company is migrating production workloads to AWS, and they are concerned about cost management across different departments. Which option should the company implement to categorize and track AWS spending?

options.text: Use the AWS Pricing Calculator service to monitor the costs incurred by each department.
Use Amazon Aurora to forecast AWS spending based on usage.
Apply cost allocation tags to segment AWS costs by different e projects and departments.
Configure AWS Price List API to receive billing updates for each department automatically.

questions.explanation: Applying cost allocation tags lets the company categorize and track AWS spending by project and department. The Pricing Calculator estimates future cost, Aurora is a database, and the Price List API returns price data, not departmental tracking.
